title.en: DELEGATING TO THE PHILIPPINE RECLAMATION AUTHORITY THE POWER TO APPROVE RECLAMATION

text.en:
The power of the President to approve reclamation
projects is hereby
delegated to the Philippine Reclamation Authority, through
its governing
board, subject to
co,mpliance with existing laws and rules and subject to the condition that reclamation contracts
to be executed with any person or entity shall go through public bidding.

Nothing in this Order shall be construed as diminishing the President's
authority to modify, amend or nullify PM's action.

All executive issuances inconsistent with this Executive Order are hereby
repealed or amended accordingly.

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 24th day of June, in the year of Our Lord, Two Thousand
.,"
By the President:
